transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I keep hearing voices. They sound clear, like somebody’s standing right there in my little studio, even when it’s quiet and nobody’s there. They say my name, and they tell me my work is being judged. It’s been really upsetting.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric?

Yes. Sometimes I feel real bright, like I’m chosen for something, and I get all these big plans like Greenville can’t even hold them all. But then I can switch fast and snap at somebody over something small, like a client asking me to repeat myself.
When you feel especially bright or chosen, do you need much less sleep than usual?
Yes. I can go a lot of nights only sleeping maybe two or three hours, and then I get up feeling charged, like I slept plenty. I’ll go right back to painting or start making calls like it’s nothing.
Do you ever hear the voices at times when you are not feeling especially up or down?

Yes. Even after that high feeling passed and my energy dropped, I was sleeping more normal, but the voices didn’t stop. And I still felt like people were judging my work or maybe tracking it somehow. That went on for weeks.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had times I felt down, but I can’t say for sure it was most of the day nearly every day for two whole weeks.
Did the voices first start soon after a major medical problem, like a seizure, head injury, or serious infection?
I don’t really know. I can’t think of any seizure or head injury or bad infection right before it started. Nothing like that stands out to me.
Have these voices and suspicious beliefs been going on for at least one month?
Yes. It’s been longer than a month. The voices and the feeling that my work is being watched have been going on for about nine months now.
During this illness, have you had a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m still not sure about that. I’ve felt low at times during all this, but I can’t clearly say it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks straight.
During the time you’ve been hearing voices, have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know for sure. I’ve had days where I felt down, but I can’t say there was a full two weeks where it was most of the day every day.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing voices even though you were not feeling especially high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes. After that time when my energy came down and I was sleeping more normal, the voices didn’t stop. I still felt like people were judging me or tracking my work, and that went on for several weeks even though I wasn’t feeling especially high or really depressed.
Have these voices and suspicious beliefs been present for at least six months in total?
Yes. It’s been about nine months now that I’ve been hearing the voices and having those fears about my work being watched.
During these nine months, was there ever a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low days and times I felt worn down, but I can’t say it was most of the day nearly every day for two full weeks.
Have the voices ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not feeling especially high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes. Like I said, after my energy came back down and I was sleeping more normal, the voices still kept going. I wasn’t feeling really high or depressed then, but I still had that feeling people were judging me or tracking my work, and that lasted for several weeks.
Before the voices began, had you ever had a manic episode?

Yes, before the voices started, I’d already had those periods where I felt really charged up and barely slept, and I’d get caught up chasing big plans. That had been coming and going for maybe around 11 months.
At any time during this illness, did the voices continue for at least one month when you were not feeling especially high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes, there was a time like that. After my energy dropped back down and I was sleeping more normal, the voices didn’t stop. They kept going, along with me feeling like people were judging me or tracking my work. That went on for several weeks.
For most of these nine months, were the voices and suspicious beliefs happening even when you were not feeling especially high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes, for a good stretch of it. After my energy came down and I was sleeping more normal, the voices still kept going, and I still believed people were judging me or keeping track of my work. That went on for several weeks, even though I wasn’t feeling especially high or depressed.
During these nine months, were you feeling high, irritable, or depressed for most of the time overall?

Yes, I think for most of that time I wasn’t really steady. A lot of it I was wound up, making big plans, not sleeping much, just going and going. And then when I came down some, I still didn’t feel fully like myself.
